verdict.rationale: PostHog's own skills store gives versioning to one kind of automation definition. Scouts in the self-driving loop are skills, and every skill edit creates an immutable version with base_version concurrency checks. Nothing documents versioning, review, or rollback for the main automation surfaces, Workflows and Hog-function CDP pipelines, so support is glancing. Missing for 10: versioning/history for Workflows and CDP pipelines, a documented review/approval step for automation changes, an explicit rollback/restore-previous-version capability, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
